instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot at eye-level, set indoors next to a window with a grey wall background. On the left, the woman in the white button-up shirt (R1) stands slightly behind, leaning forward with her left hand raised to her chin, looking down and to the right with a thoughtful, quiet expression. On the right, in the foreground, the woman in the grey long-sleeve shirt (R2) stands with both hands in her green trousers pockets, leaning against the window frame and looking down and away with a somber, pensive expression. The woman in the white shirt (R1) stands close behind the woman in the grey shirt (R2), leaning her left arm gently against her shoulder. Bright, direct sunlight streams from the right, casting sharp diagonal shadows across their bodies and the wall, highlighting a neutral color palette of white, grey, brown, and green.
